referents.why: Interrogative 'who' in 'who is this who obscures', addressed to the one answered in 38:1 (Job). The question asks who this person is.

links.why: The saying clause 'said' in 38:1 introduces the speech whose first clause is this question (R1).
The bare participle 'obscuring' right after the question clause describes its subject 'this' as it acts.

groups.why: The speech opens: the LORD (sender) speaks to Job (addressee). Its saying clause is 38:1 cl1. The turn runs on through the verses that follow.
groups.category: speech of the LORD to Job
